Say hello to Choose Browser 4.30.1! 🥳

We gave the chooser popup a massive visual glow-up while keeping our promise of absolute zero-telemetry privacy. Here is what is fresh off the build desk:

### What's New & Polished
- **8 Tailored Color Themes**: Monochrome, AMOLED, Material, Catppuccin Multi, Catppuccin Red, Dracula, Cyber Terminal, and Cyberpunk 2077. Now with deep saturated light mode hues and pastel dark mode tones 🤩.
- **Untinted Monochrome Classic**: For the purists who love the original gradient PNG icons, Monochrome keeps them completely untinted and clean 😎.
- **Offline QR Code Generator & Full-Page Viewer**: Instantly share any intercepted URL to nearby devices with zero network requests.
- **Brave Query Filter Tracking Stripper**: Automatically strips tracking tokens (`utm_*`, `fbclid`, `gclid`) right on your device before your browser even sees them 🫡.
- **Rewritten Privacy Policy**: Updated with today's date (14 November 2026) covering all our new features, sandboxed preview sessions, and zero-data-collection guarantees.
- **Crash Fixes & Layout Tweaks**: No more theme inflation hiccups on older devices or responsive screen widths.

Enjoy choosing your browser your way!
